en: The postcard is a monochrome or sepia-toned image showing a historic European market square (Markt) with classic multi-story buildings and a prominent equestrian statue in the center. Behind the square, on a hill, there is a large baroque-style castle (Schloß) with a dome and cupola. The text at the top reads 'Weissenfels a. Saale. Markt und Schloß.' Various numbers are written or crossed out on the image.
